title: Feeder Hopper Jam or Empty Alert
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petfeeder:event
| where event_type="jam" OR food_remaining_pct<10
| stats latest(food_remaining_pct) as remaining, count(eval(event_type="jam")) as jams by feeder
| where jams>0 OR remaining<10
| sort remaining
description: Combines mechanical jam events with low-food state so the smart feeder does not earn your trust and then fail at the worst possible moment.
value: Feeding automation only matters when it removes worry; this query makes sure the feeder still has both food and the ability to dispense it.
implementation: Forward smart-feeder events and hopper level; alert immediately on jams or critically low remaining food.
visualization: Current-state table of feeders with jam count and food remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It counts when the automatic feeder is stuck or almost empty and might miss the next meal.
